name: DEVONthink
description: DEVONthink is a Mac and iOS document and knowledge manager for collecting, organizing, searching, annotating, classifying, and synchronizing files, notes, web archives, email, and research databases.
agentUseSummary: DEVONthink cannot yet be connected to Relay agents because its documented AppleScript, JavaScript for Automation, smart-rule, and x-devonthink URL surfaces execute against an installed Mac app and private local databases, while Relay Marketplace does not currently ship that separate device-local authority.

blocked.label: Connect DEVONthink
blocked.description: Relay does not present a cloud connection for DEVONthink and does not silently substitute an installed Mac app or local database for Railway authority.

blocked.label: Run local automation
blocked.description: AppleScript, JavaScript for Automation, scripts, smart rules, Automator, and x-devonthink URL commands execute on a Mac with DEVONthink installed and require local automation authority Relay cannot currently mount.

blocked.label: Access private databases
blocked.description: Relay does not inspect DEVONthink databases or indexed files, automate a local or server web interface, request sync credentials, reuse app state, call private services, or execute arbitrary scripts.

blocked.label: Change DEVONthink content
blocked.description: Creating, importing, editing, moving, converting, indexing, classifying, deleting, emailing, or otherwise changing records, groups, databases, files, metadata, and scripts remains unavailable until Relay ships explicit local execution and approval boundaries.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No agent actions can be enabled until Relay ships a separately disclosed, user-authorized device-local DEVONthink connector using pinned supported automation operations.

runtimeSupport.description: Relay does not mount arbitrary DEVONthink scripts or silently bridge OpenClaw to private device-local databases.
Relay does not mount arbitrary DEVONthink scripts or silently bridge Hermes to private device-local databases.

providerSetup.blocker: DEVONtechnologies documents a broad Mac-local AppleScript/JXA dictionary, scripts and smart rules, Automator integrations, and x-devonthink URL commands, but no public third-party cloud account API. Relay's current Marketplace runtime intentionally excludes local-app command execution and cannot truthfully offer local database authority from Railway.
providerSetup.nextAction: Do not request sync credentials, inspect databases or indexed folders, automate a web interface, execute scripts, or show Connect. Reconsider after Relay ships a separately disclosed Mac local-connection architecture with app and database selection, macOS Automation permission, pinned typed operations, per-action approval, strict file/content redaction, audit, and no cloud fallback.

evidence.supports: DEVONtechnologies documents Mac automation through AppleScript, internal and triggered scripts, smart rules, Automator, application and folder actions, item links, and URL commands.
DEVONtechnologies describes robust AppleScript support that can automate nearly every aspect of DEVONthink and notes that macOS Automation permission prompts govern cross-application control.
DEVONtechnologies documents the installed application's local AppleScript dictionary and its broad record, create, move, delete, and convert object model.
DEVONtechnologies documents non-callback x-devonthink URL commands that target the local app to search and create multiple document formats with content-bearing parameters.
